handler: SIGINT and SIGTERM only store volatile sig_atomic_t; no handler I/O, allocation, estimator mutation or longjmp.
boundary: Complete the active ingest/output transaction; stop before the next ingestion. If a signal arrives after a complete record read but before ingest, leave that record unassimilated and include it in the35-record ring. Entering failure checkpoint equals current live bank at the safe boundary.
outputs: Nonzero exit and receipt operation=supervisor_stop, code=-200-signum, supervisor_signal field. Existing canonical entering/current snapshots, raw-state fallback, input ring and failure JSON preserved. No automatic reset or retry.
root_monitor_policy: Request SIGINT on cap breach; permit at most1s diagnostic flush, then SIGKILL if needed. Root records cap violation regardless of child status; hard kill has explicitly unavailable cooperative capture.
